title: Spreadsheet Anatomy & Data Types
concepts: Rows, columns, cells, ranges, text, numbers, dates, percentages and why data types matter.
objectives: Enter and format a clean table
practical: Create a 20-row participant table, format headers, freeze row 1, and identify numeric vs text fields.
ai_use: Ask AI to explain a concept using your own small example. Do not ask it to complete the exercise.
exercise: Build and format a small participant register.

title: SUM, AVERAGE, MEDIAN, MIN, MAX & COUNT
concepts: Basic descriptive statistics and the difference between average and median.
objectives: Check whether a result is reasonable
practical: Calculate score summaries from a participant test table and change source values to confirm formulas update.
ai_use: Ask AI: 'Explain why mean and median may differ. Give me a new example, but do not solve my dataset.'
exercise: Summarize test scores and explain mean vs median.

title: Percentages & Relative References
concepts: Part/whole percentages, percentage formatting and formula copying.
practical: Calculate attendance percentage from sessions attended / total sessions and fill the formula down.
ai_use: Ask AI to check your formula structure, not the final values.

title: IF Logic for Data Classification
concepts: Boolean thinking: condition, result if true, result if false.
objectives: Translate a written rule into logic
practical: Classify learners as Pass/Fail and Eligible/Not Eligible using stated thresholds.
ai_use: Give AI the business rule and your formula; ask it to critique the logic and test edge cases.

title: Sort, Filter & Conditional Formatting
concepts: Inspecting subsets without deleting data and visually flagging values.
practical: Filter one county, sort scores high-to-low and highlight low performance.
ai_use: Ask AI for three questions you could answer with the current table; choose one and answer it yourself.
exercise: Find top/bottom performers and filtered groups.

title: COUNTIF, SUMIF & AVERAGEIF
concepts: One-condition summaries by category.
practical: Create county and product summaries using one-condition functions.
ai_use: Ask AI to explain the difference between COUNTIF, SUMIF and AVERAGEIF in plain language.

title: Text Cleaning: TRIM, PROPER & Standardization
concepts: Why visually similar text can be analytically different.
practical: Duplicate the raw sheet, standardize names/counties and compare category counts before vs after.
ai_use: Ask AI for a checklist of text-quality problems to inspect; do the cleaning yourself.

title: Dates, Missing Values & Duplicates
concepts: Dates as values, blanks vs zero, duplicate detection and documentation.
practical: Create a small data-quality log showing issue type, count, decision and affected field.
ai_use: Ask AI to challenge your cleaning decision: 'What could go wrong if I replace blanks with zero?'
exercise: Audit and clean a registration dataset.

title: Charts & Evidence-Based Findings
concepts: Choosing a chart for comparison, trend or composition and writing findings from evidence.
practical: Build a county comparison chart and a simple score distribution chart; write four findings.
ai_use: Ask AI to critique whether each finding is actually supported by the data.

title: Beginner Capstone: One-Table Analysis
concepts: End-to-end beginner workflow: understand, clean, calculate, summarize, visualize, check and explain.
practical: Analyze a community training dataset from raw records to management summary.
ai_use: After completing the project, ask AI to act as an assessor and question your choices; do not let it rewrite your workbook.

title: Absolute References, AND & OR
concepts: Fixed rule cells and combining multiple conditions.
practical: Store thresholds in a Rules area and build qualification/priority statuses.
ai_use: Ask AI to generate edge cases that could break your rule.
exercise: Build a reusable staff eligibility model.

title: COUNTIFS, SUMIFS & AVERAGEIFS
concepts: Multiple simultaneous conditions across text, numbers and dates.
practical: Summarize participants and cost by county, program, gender and period.
ai_use: Ask AI to inspect your criteria logic and point out mismatched-range risks.

title: VLOOKUP & Exact Matching
concepts: Lookup keys, exact match and why approximate matching can be dangerous.
practical: Bring county/program fields from a master table into visit records.
ai_use: Ask AI to explain what each argument in your VLOOKUP means using your formula.
exercise: Enrich transaction data from a master list.

title: XLOOKUP & IFERROR
concepts: More flexible lookups and transparent handling of missing keys.
practical: Replace a VLOOKUP-based solution with XLOOKUP and create an unmatched-record exception count.
ai_use: Ask AI to compare VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP, then verify its claims against Google Sheets behavior.

title: Cross-Sheet Reconciliation
concepts: Matching two sources and explaining differences.
practical: Reconcile registration and attendance sheets and produce two exception tables.
ai_use: Ask AI for questions an auditor would ask about your reconciliation.

title: Pivot Tables
concepts: Fast grouped summaries and validation of grand totals.
practical: Summarize actuals by county and activity, then compare to source totals.
ai_use: Ask AI to suggest a pivot layout for a stated question; build and verify it yourself.

title: Pivot Charts, Slicers & Interactive Views
concepts: Turning grouped summaries into interactive analysis.
practical: Create a management view by county and officer with an interactive filter.
ai_use: Ask AI to critique your chart choice and suggest a clearer alternative if needed.

title: Data Quality Audit
concepts: Systematic issue counts: missingness, duplicates, invalid ranges and unmatched keys.
practical: Create a QA sheet with issue counts and row-level flags.
ai_use: Ask AI to review your QA checklist for missing control types.

title: KPI Design & Business Questions
concepts: Turning vague management questions into measurable metrics.
practical: Design five KPIs from a program brief, then implement them in a summary sheet.
ai_use: Ask AI to challenge each KPI definition for ambiguity or unintended incentives.
exercise: Create a KPI definition and calculation sheet.

title: Intermediate Capstone
concepts: Multi-sheet analysis with lookups, pivots, QA and management summary.
practical: Build a two-source monitoring report with a management page and QA page.
ai_use: Use AI only after your first version; ask it to audit logic, not create the whole solution.

title: SQL SELECT, WHERE & ORDER BY
concepts: Querying rows and columns from structured data.
practical: Load the exercise CSV into SQLite/DB tool and answer six business questions.
ai_use: Ask AI to explain an SQL error message and give a hint, not a finished answer.

title: SQL Aggregation & GROUP BY
concepts: COUNT, SUM, AVG and grouped business summaries.
practical: Calculate totals and averages by county/program and filter grouped results.
ai_use: Ask AI to test whether your GROUP BY answers the intended business question.

title: SQL JOINs
concepts: Combining normalized tables using keys.
practical: Join people, activities and reference tables and produce an unmatched-key report.
ai_use: Ask AI to draw the join logic in words before you run it, then compare with actual results.

title: SQL CTEs & Window Functions
concepts: Readable multi-step queries, ranking and cumulative calculations.
practical: Rank performers within county and compute cumulative monthly actuals.
ai_use: Ask AI to explain the difference between GROUP BY and window functions with a fresh example.

title: Power Query: Import & Transform
concepts: Repeatable data ingestion and transformation.
practical: Import two exercise tables, clean types/text and create a reproducible transformation pipeline.
ai_use: Ask AI to explain a Power Query step or error; verify against the Applied Steps pane.
exercise: Build a repeatable Power Query cleaning pipeline.

title: Power BI Data Modeling
concepts: Fact/dimension design, relationships and star-schema thinking.
practical: Model transactions, people, calendar and program tables.
ai_use: Describe your proposed model to AI and ask it to identify relationship risks; validate in Model view.

title: DAX Measures & Filter Context
concepts: Measures vs columns, CALCULATE and filter context.
practical: Build Total Actual, Total Target, Achievement %, Distinct People and YTD measures.
ai_use: Ask AI to explain your DAX measure line-by-line; then test it under slicers.

title: Statistics for Analysts
concepts: Distribution, variance, standard deviation, outliers, correlation and sampling caution.
practical: Analyze a numeric dataset, compare mean/median, inspect outliers and calculate correlation.
ai_use: Ask AI for alternative explanations for an observed correlation.

title: Dashboard Design & Data Storytelling
concepts: Decision-focused visuals, hierarchy, accessibility and narrative.
practical: Redesign a cluttered dashboard brief into one executive page plus one diagnostic page.
ai_use: Ask AI to critique the dashboard from the perspective of a busy manager.

title: Advanced Capstone
concepts: From raw relational data to SQL analysis, Power BI model, measures, dashboard and QA.
practical: Complete an end-to-end program performance analysis with source reconciliation.
ai_use: Use AI as reviewer: request five audit questions and answer them from your model.

title: Python & pandas Foundations
concepts: DataFrames, columns, filtering, selecting, basic summaries and reproducibility.
practical: Load an exercise dataset with pandas and reproduce key summaries previously done in Sheets.
ai_use: Ask AI to explain code you wrote, not to generate an entire notebook from scratch.

title: pandas Cleaning & Missing Data
concepts: String cleaning, types, missing values, duplicates and validation.
practical: Clean a messy operational dataset and create a quality report.
ai_use: Ask AI to propose tests for your cleaning rules; implement and inspect the tests yourself.
exercise: Build a reproducible pandas cleaning pipeline.

title: pandas Merge, GroupBy & Pivot
concepts: Combining tables and producing analytical summaries.
practical: Merge people and activity tables, summarize by county/program and surface unmatched keys.
ai_use: Ask AI to review your merge cardinality assumptions.

title: Python Visualization
concepts: Clear analytical plots and avoiding misleading visuals.
practical: Create four plots answering specified questions, each on its own figure.
ai_use: Ask AI to critique the interpretation, not merely the aesthetics.

title: Exploratory Data Analysis & Anomaly Detection
concepts: Systematic profiling, distributions, segment comparisons and anomaly investigation.
practical: Create an EDA report and investigate the top five anomalies.
ai_use: Ask AI for plausible hypotheses, then label them explicitly as hypotheses until verified.
exercise: Perform structured EDA and anomaly investigation.

title: Automation & Reproducible Reporting
concepts: Functions, configuration, file outputs, logging and repeatable refresh.
practical: Turn a manual analysis into a script that reads raw files and writes cleaned data plus a summary.
ai_use: Ask AI to review code organization and suggest tests, not business assumptions.

title: Experimentation & A/B Test Thinking
concepts: Hypotheses, treatment/control, effect size, uncertainty and common pitfalls.
practical: Analyze a synthetic intervention dataset and write a cautious decision memo.
ai_use: Ask AI to argue against your conclusion and identify threats to validity.

title: Forecasting Fundamentals & Limits
concepts: Time-series structure, baseline forecasts, seasonality and uncertainty.
practical: Build a moving-average or simple trend baseline and evaluate error.
ai_use: Ask AI to identify reasons your forecast may fail in production.
exercise: Create and evaluate a baseline forecast.

title: Governance, Privacy, Versioning & Documentation
concepts: Data ownership, access, reproducibility, change logs and responsible handling.
practical: Design governance controls for a reporting system and create a change log.
ai_use: Ask AI to review the governance plan for missing operational risks; never paste sensitive real data.
exercise: Create a governance and auditability pack.

title: Pro Capstone
concepts: Automated multi-source analysis with reproducible cleaning, QA, dashboard-ready outputs and documentation.
practical: Build a repeatable analysis package from multiple raw files.
ai_use: Use AI as a code reviewer and skeptical analyst; retain human ownership of all conclusions.

title: Analytical Problem Framing
concepts: From vague stakeholder request to decision, metric, population, grain, constraints and success criteria.
practical: Turn three vague management questions into precise analysis plans.
ai_use: Ask AI to play a difficult stakeholder and challenge missing assumptions.

title: Multi-Source Architecture & Lineage
concepts: Source, staging, model, semantic/report and QA layers with lineage.
practical: Design an architecture for five sources with owners and refresh rules.
ai_use: Ask AI to identify single points of failure in your architecture.
exercise: Create a data-flow and lineage design.

title: Metric Layer & Semantic Consistency
concepts: Single definitions for KPIs, dimensions, time logic and business rules.
practical: Design a metric layer for a program with monthly, quarterly and annual reporting.
ai_use: Ask AI to find ambiguous KPI definitions and propose questions, not definitions.

title: Causal Reasoning & Decision Risk
concepts: Confounding, selection bias, causality vs correlation and decision uncertainty.
practical: Review a case where performance improved and assess whether the intervention caused it.
ai_use: Ask AI to generate competing causal explanations and evidence needed to distinguish them.

title: Executive Communication & Analytical Narrative
concepts: What executives need: decision, evidence, risk, recommendation and next action.
practical: Convert a technical analysis into a one-page executive brief.
ai_use: Ask AI to critique clarity for a non-technical executive; do not let it change facts.

title: Model QA, Audit & Reconciliation
concepts: Control totals, regression checks, source-to-report tracing and test design.
practical: Audit a supplied model and create a structured test matrix.
ai_use: Ask AI to generate adversarial test cases after you define the business rules.
exercise: Create a model QA and audit report.

title: AI-Assisted Analytics Workflow
concepts: Using AI for explanation, debugging, hypothesis generation, critique and documentation without surrendering verification.
practical: Run a controlled AI-assisted analysis using a verification log: prompt, AI claim, evidence checked, final decision.
ai_use: Use AI as tutor/reviewer/adversary; never treat its output as a source of truth.
exercise: Create an AI-assisted analysis verification log.

title: Live Change Request & Regression Testing
concepts: Changing a business rule safely across formulas, SQL, measures or code.
practical: Apply a late KPI-rule change and prove unrelated outputs did not change.
ai_use: Ask AI to propose regression tests, then independently judge whether they are sufficient.
exercise: Implement and validate a change request.

title: Stakeholder Defense & Technical Review
concepts: Defending methods, assumptions and findings under questioning.
practical: Prepare a 10-minute walkthrough and answer an assessor's technical and management questions.
ai_use: Ask AI to conduct a hostile-but-fair mock defense and score your responses.

title: Final Expert Capstone
concepts: End-to-end expert system: problem framing, multi-source data, cleaning, SQL/Python/BI, QA, AI verification, governance and executive communication.
practical: Complete the final multi-source assessment and submit system, dashboard, QA report, AI-use log, executive brief and oral defense.
ai_use: AI may assist with debugging, critique and testing, but every conclusion and calculation must be independently verified and explainable.
